meta.status: Compiled from the uploaded CBIC notification texts (9/2025, 10/2025, 15/2025, 11/2017 with 2026 amendments noted). Not yet checked line-by-line against the live CBIC portal. Confirm each entry before relying on it.

change_log.what: 30 sample records added from uploaded notification texts

records.name: Rice (pre-packaged and labelled)
records.condition: Pre-packaged and labelled

records.name: Rice (loose, not pre-packaged)
records.condition: Other than pre-packaged and labelled
records.note: Exempt, so no tax is charged.

records.name: Wheat (pre-packaged and labelled)
records.condition: Pre-packaged and labelled

records.name: Wheat or meslin flour (atta, maida), pre-packaged
records.condition: Pre-packaged and labelled

records.name: Fresh, pasteurised or UHT milk
records.condition: Not concentrated and no added sugar

records.name: Milk and cream, concentrated or sweetened (incl. condensed milk)
records.condition: Concentrated or containing added sugar

records.name: Chena or paneer
records.condition: Whether or not pre-packaged and labelled

records.name: Natural honey (pre-packaged and labelled)
records.condition: Pre-packaged and labelled
records.note: Loose honey is exempt under 10/2025, S.No 19.

records.name: Tea (processed)
records.condition: Other than unprocessed green leaves

records.name: Coffee, roasted
records.condition: Roasted, not raw beans
records.note: Coffee beans not roasted are exempt under 10/2025, S.No 57.

records.name: Sugar (cane or beet, pre-packaged)
records.condition: Other than jaggery and khandsari

records.name: Jaggery (gur), pre-packaged and labelled
records.condition: Pre-packaged and labelled
records.note: Jaggery other than pre-packaged is exempt under 10/2025, S.No 96.

records.name: Articles of jewellery of precious metal (gold, silver)
records.condition: Articles of jewellery of precious metal
records.note: Unwrought gold and silver are in Schedule IV, S.Nos 5 and 3. Check the notification before invoicing bullion.

records.name: Automatic data processing machines (laptops, computers)
records.note: Confirm the Schedule for your exact model before invoicing.

records.name: Drugs and medicines (not in Annexure I of 10/2025)
records.condition: Other than items at nil under 10/2025, Annexure I (S.No 113)
records.note: Check the 10/2025 Annexure I list for specific drugs at nil rate.

records.name: Electrically operated vehicles (incl. e-2W, e-3W, e-bicycles)
records.condition: Run solely on electrical energy (per the notification's explanation)
records.note: Listed at chapter level (HSN 87). Confirm the exact vehicle category on the notification.

records.name: Bicycles and other non-motorised cycles
records.condition: Non-motorised

records.name: Motor cars (other than small cars in Schedule II)
records.condition: Excludes items at Schedule II, S.Nos 533 to 539 (ambulances and listed small petrol, CNG, LPG and diesel cars)
records.note: Small cars and some EVs fall under other entries. Verify the exact vehicle before invoicing.

records.name: Motorcycles (engine capacity above 350 cc)
records.condition: Engine capacity exceeding 350 cc
records.note: Motorcycles up to 350 cc are not in this dataset yet.

records.name: Cigarettes, cigars, biris and other tobacco products
records.note: Compensation cess on tobacco is set by a separate notification that is not in the uploaded files. Verify before use.
records.cess: Compensation cess on tobacco is set by a separate notification not in the uploaded files - verify

records.name: Footwear (sale value up to Rs 2,500 per pair)
records.condition: Sale value not exceeding Rs 2,500 per pair

records.name: Footwear (sale value above Rs 2,500 per pair)
records.condition: Sale value above Rs 2,500 per pair
records.note: Confirm the price threshold entry by entry on the notification.

records.name: Apparel and clothing accessories (sale value up to Rs 2,500 per piece)
records.condition: Sale value up to Rs 2,500 per piece

records.name: Apparel and clothing accessories (sale value above Rs 2,500 per piece)
records.condition: Sale value above Rs 2,500 per piece

records.name: Restaurant service (no air-conditioning, no liquor licence)
records.condition: No air-conditioning or central air-heating at any time in the year, and no liquor licence
records.note: Rate revised by 15/2025 with effect from 22 Sep 2025.

records.name: Restaurant service (air-conditioned or licensed to serve liquor)
records.condition: Air-conditioned or centrally air-heated, or licensed to serve alcoholic liquor

records.name: Air travel, economy class
records.condition: Economy class; ITC proviso applies (goods used in supply not credited)
records.note: Air travel other than economy class is a separate entry, not in this dataset yet.

records.name: Rail travel, first class or air-conditioned coach
records.condition: First class or air-conditioned coach; ITC proviso applies
records.note: Other rail classes are not in this dataset yet.

records.name: Goods transport agency (road freight)
records.condition: Issues a consignment note; ITC proviso applies
records.note: The GTA definition was amended by 06/2026 with effect from 1 Nov 2026. Verify the current definition.

records.name: Tour operator services
records.condition: Bill shows the inclusive gross amount for accommodation and transport; ITC proviso applies

records.name: Beauty and physical well-being services (salon, spa)
records.condition: Group 99972 services; ITC proviso applies
records.note: Other washing, cleaning and dyeing services are in entry 35(ii) at 9%.

records.name: Transport of passengers by motorcab (fuel included)
records.condition: Cost of fuel is included in the consideration charged to the recipient
records.note: Renting of motorcab with fuel is entry 10(i) at 2.5%.

records.name: Construction of a residential building or complex for sale
records.condition: Applies until the completion certificate or first occupation, whichever is earlier, for the entire consideration received
records.note: Valuation rules in paragraph 2 of the notification apply. Confirm with a tax professional before invoicing.
